About US

MEET WONDER VEGGIES

We are agrifoodtech innovators on a mission to revolutionize the vegetable market by marrying the benefits of fresh vegetables with healthy probiotics
Join OUR MISSION

WHY PROBIOTICS?

Balance the friendly bacteria in the digestive system

Can reduce levels of low-density lipoprotein

Can help reduce symptoms of certain digestive disorders

May help losing weight and belly fat

May reduce the severity of certain allergies and eczema

Can help keep the heart healthy

May help boost the immune system

Improve some mental health conditions

BENEFITS

WHY PROBIOTICS+ VEGETABLES?

Vegetables are the optimal probiotics carrier offering a synbiotic effect.

  • Protecting the probiotics from the harsh environment in the gastrointestinal tract on their way to the gut
  • Facilitating the growth and activity of probiotic microorganisms in the gut
